new_findings.title: The first bundled comic page still has discontinuous hidden-area continuations
new_findings.evidence: Direct source-image inspection confirms a horizontal join at source row 178 through the rectangular speech balloon: its vertical marks change alignment across the boundary. At row 1269, the lower radial lines, crosshatch phase and silhouette change abruptly. The extraction script pastes the original PDF clip into [0,178,1172,1269) over older synthetic upper and lower art. The final candidate's closed Reader exposes these regions, and the landscape vertical case makes the upper mismatch particularly clear.
new_findings.suggestion: Continue the first page's observed geometry and pattern phases above and below its preserved PDF clip, as was done for the second page. Keep fitting, renderer behavior and the observed original clip intact.
new_findings.review_note: The round-1 asset diagnosis focused on page-01 and did not close the same continuation defect in page-00. This is now a confirmed additional source-art finding rather than a renderer defect, and this round cannot count as clean.
new_findings.disposition: Root accepted a front-page continuation repair. Its first complete after image, upper/middle/lower crops, both boundary crops at 2x and the enlarged vertical view were independently inspected. The balloon and three vertical marks, horizontal-line phase, lower ray geometry, crosshatch phase and silhouette now appear continuous with no new visible gray band. A new frozen candidate and two fresh clean rounds are still required.

repair_preflight.before_provenance_note: The top-level before PNG is the original byte-for-byte asset with SHA-256 0b8d. The candidate-1 before preview was re-encoded with identical pixels and is not represented as the original byte-copy.
repair_preflight.reported_source_preservation: The original UI header-separator row 178 is explicitly replaced, changing 1136 pixels. The preserved PDF artwork is [0,179,1172,1269), containing 1277480 pixels with zero mismatches; dimensions remain 1172 by 1648. These remote measurements were read, not rerun locally, and were not substituted for visual inspection.

scope_note: Every screenshot listed here is a fresh round-2 capture on candidate 4, not a substituted round-1 image. The complete independent manual UI scope covers 51 primary and 41 supporting fresh captures, including all twelve PDF baselines. Both round-1 repairs are confirmed in fresh application images. One newly confirmed continuation defect in the first source page requires another asset repair, so this complete manual review does not qualify as a clean round despite all four remote automated matrices passing.

observations: Default reading contains only the comic and fitting background, including the former top and bottom chrome area.

The repaired odd-page artwork is visible after seek commit and ordinary bottom-right navigation. Its upper gray background, rays, speech bubbles and bottom stripes are continuous; neither the original repeated strips nor the first repair's tone boundary is visible.
Seek preview remains in the explicitly opened menu with the desired page information; commit returns to pure imagery.
Panel closure, Escape and table-of-contents selection return to comic-only imagery. Bottom-right RTL, LTR and vertical samples perform ordinary reading navigation.
The library retains its Reading filter and page 2 of 2 after restart. The cross-book detail pair retains the second book, and the Reader restart pair retains its accepted image.

The vertical restart pair retains page 1, offset 1401 and zoom 2 with matching framing. Desktop lifecycle baseline/resume retain page 20 and two image jobs started; double-tap reset ends at its intended page 13 with zoom 1, and cancelled seek remains at page 12. These desktop observations are not native park evidence.
The page-8 failure offers an explicit retry and continued reading of page 7; successful retry returns to pure page-8 artwork.
The first-page failure offers visible retry and return actions, and a successful retry displays the first page without permanent chrome.

Cross-chapter failure, retry and continued-reading destinations visibly identify chapter 2 and chapter 1. Retry-in-progress is disabled with loading feedback, then accepts chapter 2 and clears the panel.
Pending menu projection describes displayed page 7 while the requested page is 8. Bookmark, export and cover targets remain bound to displayed page 7.

Before the first accepted image, a centered loading label gives feedback. Attempting an image action opens a readable wait-for-image panel; dismissing it restores loading. Reviewed reason labels remain safe categories without source error text.

observations: Active real-worker success notices do not add visible chrome to closed Paperwhite or landscape Reader images.
The complete landscape spread shows the repaired second page without a decorative gutter, repeated sections or the former upper tone boundary.

The last-page case uses a single image with proportional fitting and no empty decorative page slot. Landscape vertical reading uses the full viewport without menu, status, page labels or bookmark marks.
The landscape vertical view additionally exposed the separately reported first-page source-art join; the exact oracle correctly verifies rendering of its source pixels, not artistic continuity.
